description: Music catalog deal-review guardrails. PreToolUse blocks writes into deals/{deal-id}/source/ (immutable evidence). Stop is workspace-scoped + deterministic: it stays SILENT unless the project is a catalog deal workspace (has deals/) AND either the agent claims a package is ready (Gate A) or an end-to-end /recoup-catalog-deal run is active (Gate B); only then does it run the shipped validators (run-deal-checks.py / validate-dashboard.py) and block. Replaces the always-on LLM reviewer that fired in every workspace.
